subject.title: Plugin `message_sending` hooks silently bypassed on channel agent-reply delivery paths (2026.5.26, still present in 2026.6.1)

question: Does current main's centralized outbound-delivery path already cover Telegram preview-finalized replies exactly once, or should one selected PR provide the missing explicit bridge before this issue is closed?
rationale: The linked PRs differ on the ownership and exactly-once semantics of Telegram streaming finalization; source evidence establishes the generic hook boundary but does not conclusively connect that special delivery path to it.

options.title: Validate current-main coverage
options.body: Trace a real Telegram preview-finalized reply through the current centralized delivery path and close the issue only if it invokes message_sending once with correct rewrite and cancellation behavior.

options.title: Adopt a canonical fix PR
options.body: Choose one linked candidate, rebase it, and retain only the minimal changes needed to cover the configured-delivery and streaming-final paths without duplicate invocation.

options.title: Split the delivery invariant
options.body: Land the ordinary configured-delivery repair separately and keep a narrowly scoped follow-up open for Telegram preview-finalized handling if its lifecycle needs a distinct owner boundary.

recommendation.title: Validate current-main coverage
recommendation.body: Trace a real Telegram preview-finalized reply through the current centralized delivery path and close the issue only if it invokes message_sending once with correct rewrite and cancellation behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the current assignee and is best positioned to make or obtain the implementation-boundary decision.
